correctness.rationale: An order ideal in vertex-edge incidence P(K_{2,n}) has left bits A,B and, per labelled right vertex, one of 2,3,3,5 allowed local codes, so |J|=2^n+2*3^n+5^n. Rowmotion is directly generated by minimal complement; global left-bit updates depend only on the support T of distinct local codes and each column update on its own code and the global bits. All 48 pairs (L,T) for nonempty supports are represented exactly once and classified by a direct 48-case support-period certificate: periods 2,3,4,6,8,24, with counts across k=1..5 as in RESULT.md. For a fixed support of size k and n labelled columns the multiplicity is S_k(n)=sum_i (-1)^i binom(k,i)(k-i)^n. Dividing m_{d,k}S_k(n) by d yields the six stated cycle formulas; weighted total equals the ideal count. k=1 representatives have periods 3 and 8 for every n>=1, forcing exact permutation order lcm(3,8)=24 even when no length-24 orbit exists (n=1,2). True 24-cycles first appear at n>=3.
residual_risks: Classical labelled order-ideal rowmotion only, for P(K_{2,n}) n>=1; no asserted birational order or general K_{m,n} formula.
The finite 48-support table is exhaustive because the structural reduction is proved, not because small n experiments extrapolate.
